audience: software teams that use Azure Repos, Pipelines and Boards in one organization

useCases.title: Find pull requests waiting for review
useCases.text: List the projects, then the Git repositories of one project. List the active pull requests of one repository.

useCases.title: Read a pull request before you review it
useCases.text: Open one pull request to read its title, description, reviewers, and source and target branches.

useCases.title: Check recent pipeline failures
useCases.text: List the pipelines of a project, then the recent builds of one pipeline. Open a build to read its result and branch.

useCases.title: Query work items
useCases.text: Run a WIQL query to get the ids of matching work items, then read the fields of those items in one batch.

useCases.title: Create a task and comment on a pull request
useCases.text: Create a work item, such as a task or a bug, in a project. Post a new comment thread on a pull request.
